claim: The symbolic real-Python operation acquired and preserved by M097 survives complete producer-process death as canonical disk state: fresh isolated base-Python consumers with no repository, acquisition or validation modules can decode and execute it across all three post-M097 qualification worlds; removing, semantically mutating or corrupting the extension closes the capability, and byte-exact rollback restores it in another fresh process.
falsifiers: The protocol, pool, runtime, checker or preserved M097 input differs from its frozen content binding.
Any qualification world was executed by the persisted-state producer or fresh runtime before freeze, or any M097 development or qualification world was reused.
The producer does not write the exact canonical M097 state or remains alive when consumers begin.
The consumer capsule contains anything beyond the bound generic runtime and entry point.
Any of the three fresh post-M097 worlds fails execution after restart with the preserved extension.
A consumer is not in Python isolated mode, imports a project module or retains the repository on its import search path.
A fresh consumer succeeds when the persisted extension registry is empty.
A well-formed semantic mutation succeeds, or a raw state corruption does not fail closed.
Consumer invocation occurs in the producer process, a consumer omits its PID, or the producer death boundary is not established first.
Replacing the live state with the semantic mutation does not suppress the capability in a new process.
Rollback does not restore the exact original bytes or another fresh process fails after restoration.
Stable evidence differs on clean replay, the result is overwritten or rerolled, or model, network, remote or dirty-tree evidence enters Track A.

process_boundary.producer: standalone base-Python process writes canonical M097 state and manifest, then exits
process_boundary.consumer: fresh base-Python -I process launched only after producer termination
process_boundary.pid_reuse_note: Every invocation is a new subprocess; OS PID reuse between completed consumers is permitted, but no consumer may equal the already terminated producer PID.

rollback.fault: replace the live canonical state with a digest-valid semantic SUB-to-ADD mutation
rollback.restore: write back the exact original byte string
rollback.restore_verdict: raw sha256 must return exactly and another fresh consumer must succeed

mechanism.digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON mapping each listed path to its raw sha256

qualification_apparatus.digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON mapping each listed path to its raw sha256

qualification_population.construction: all three authored post-M097 structures; no draw, exclusion, salt or reroll

owner_authorization: The project owner instructed continued local validation through M096, M097 and M098 on 2026-08-22. This authorizes local freeze and execution, not public push.
verdict_rule: positive only when all twelve frozen conditions are computed and true
